name: Jordan
label: Free and premium on-off
who: I move between the free tier and Premium depending on whether I can pay consistently, and I often get confused when premium features appear or disappear on my account. I care about ad-free listening and being able to skip, and I'm frustrated by renewal prompts after cancelling.
value_for_money: Mixed. Says the free version is a poor experience and Premium is cheap for what you get, but admits that paying is hard some months.
loyalty: Keeps Premium for ad-free listening and unlimited skips when affordable. Has cancelled before and finds the reminders to renew after cancelling annoying.
pain_points: Premium features appearing and disappearing randomly
Confusing free trial offers and eligibility
The free version only lets you shuffle
tone: Casual and a bit exasperated, writing in short messages about confusing account behavior.
